gloss: to drink up; to finish drinking

definitions.gloss: to drink up; to finish drinking; to drain
definitions.explanation: To drink something completely, leaving nothing remaining. The emphasis is on finishing the entire amount of a beverage.

examples.japanese: ⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I drank up all the juice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧{飲|の}み⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take all of the medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ボトル→ボトル：11270_botoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今日中|きょうじゅう}→今日中：19382_kyoujuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飲|の}み⟦{切|き}らない→切る：02693_kiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{炭酸|たんさん}→炭酸：13376_tansan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けて→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧しまう。
examples.english: If we don't finish this bottle today, it'll go flat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}→牛乳：00777_gyuunyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{賞味期限|しょうみきげん}→賞味期限：06076_shoumikigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飲|の}み⟦{切|き}ろう→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: The milk is near its expiration date, so let's finish it soon.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink) and ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (completive suffix meaning to finish completely). Part of the productive V + ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ pattern where ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ indicates doing something to completion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{切|き}る: to finish one's beer
- ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{切|き}る: to take all of the medicine
- ⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飲|の}み{切|き}る: to drink up in one go
- ⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{切|き}れない→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: can't finish drinking (it all)

RELATED PATTERNS:
The V + ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ pattern is used with many verbs to express completion:
- ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to eat up completely
- ⟦{使|つか}い{切|き}る→使い切る：11518_tsukaikiru⟧: to use up completely
- ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to read all the way through

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飲|の}み{干|ほ}す→飲み干す：21473_nomihosu⟧: to drain, drink dry — more literary; emphasizes draining a vessel completely
- ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to drink — basic verb without the completion nuance
